newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis sees French 97 growth at least 2.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis sees French 97 growth at least 2.3 percent.

text.p: Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said Tuesday French economic growth would be at least 2.3 percent in 1997 and a minimum of 2.8 percent next year.

The government's official forecasts are for 2.3 percent this year and 2.8 percent in 1998, although economists have suggested these forecasts could be distorted by the effect on investment of an early May-June parliamentary election.
"Growth is on the right trend. At least 2.3 percent for 1997 and certainly 2.8 percent for 1998," he said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.
He added that 2.8 percent "is a minimum for 1998."
He also said the French government was defending its position in the election to continue its policies of public deficit reduction.
"We are defending our position to continue." He said the government's track record was clear. "This is the right track to prepare France for the euro in January 1999."
